meta.dc:subject: legislation
meta.dc:rights: the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

section.name: s2
section.heading: Interpretation
section.def: air transhipment cargo (航空轉運貨物) has the meaning given by section 2 of the Import and Export Ordinance (Cap. 60);
compounded food (合成食物) means food containing 2 or more ingredients;
Director (署長) means the Director of Food and Environmental Hygiene;
exempted pesticide (獲豁免除害劑) means any pesticide that is set out in Schedule 2;

extraneous maximum residue limit and EMRL (最高再殘餘限量), in relation to the residue definition specified in column 3 of Part 2 of Schedule 1 of a pesticide specified in column 2 of that Part, mean the extraneous maximum residue limit for that residue definition specified, in column 5 of that Part (as read with Part 3 of that Schedule), opposite to the pesticide;

maximum residue limit and MRL (最高殘餘限量), in relation to the residue definition specified in column 3 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 of a pesticide specified in column 2 of that Part, mean the maximum residue limit for that residue definition specified, in column 5 of that Part (as read with Part 3 of that Schedule), opposite to the pesticide;

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.leadIn: any substance intended for preventing, destroying, attracting, repelling or controlling any pest (including any unwanted species of plants, animals, birds or aquatic products) during the production, storage, transport, distribution or processing of—

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.content: fodder, or feeding stuffs, for animals, birds or aquatic products;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: any substance which may be administered to animals, birds or aquatic products for the control of ectoparasites;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: any substance intended for use as a plant growth regulator, defoliant, desiccant, fruit thinning agent or sprouting inhibitor; and

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: any substance applied to crops before or after harvest to protect them from deterioration during storage or transport,

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.content: fertilizers;

paragraph.name: f
paragraph.content: nutrients for plants, animals, birds or aquatic products;

paragraph.name: g
paragraph.content: food additives; or

paragraph.name: h
paragraph.content: drugs for animals, birds or aquatic products;

section.def: pesticide residues (除害劑殘餘) means any substance present in food resulting from the use of pesticide, and includes any derivatives and impurities of toxicological significance;

def.name: PrimaryFoodCommodity
def.leadIn: primary food commodity (原食品) means a product in, or nearly in, its natural state that—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: is intended for processing into food for sale; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: can serve as food without further processing;

section.def: residue definition (殘餘物定義), in relation to a pesticide, means the combination of the pesticide and its derivatives or related compounds.

section.name: s3
section.heading: Application
section.leadIn: This Regulation does not apply to food which is imported solely for the purpose of export if the food—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: is air transhipment cargo; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: during the period between its import and export, remains in the vessel, vehicle or aircraft in which it was imported.

section.name: s4
section.heading: Import, sale etc. of food containing pesticide residues

subsection.leadIn: A person may import, consign, deliver, manufacture or sell for human consumption a food which contains pesticide residues only if—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.leadIn: the food is of a description specified in column 4 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 and—

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: the pesticide residues are the pesticide residues of a pesticide specified, in column 2 of that Part, opposite to the food; and

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.content: the concentration of the pesticide residues in the food does not exceed the MRL for the residue definition of the pesticide specified, in column 3 of that Part, opposite to the food;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.leadIn: the food is of a description specified in column 4 of Part 2 of Schedule 1 and—

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: the pesticide residues are the pesticide residues of a pesticide specified, in column 2 of that Part, opposite to the food; and

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.content: the concentration of the pesticide residues in the food does not exceed the EMRL for the residue definition of the pesticide specified, in column 3 of that Part, opposite to the food;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: the pesticide residues are the pesticide residues of an exempted pesticide;

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: section 5 applies to the food and the concentration of the pesticide residues in the food does not exceed the MRL or EMRL applicable to the food by virtue of that section;

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.content: section 6 applies to the food and the concentration of the pesticide residues in the food does not exceed the aggregated MRL or EMRL applicable to the food by virtue of that section; or

paragraph.name: f
paragraph.content: any of the conditions set out in subsection (2) is met (except for cases that also fall within paragraph (d) or (e)) and, having regard to the factors set out in section 7, consumption of the food is not dangerous or prejudicial to health.

subsection.leadIn: The conditions referred to in subsection (1)(f) are—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the food is not of a description specified in column 4 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 or column 4 of Part 2 of that Schedule; or

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: is of a description specified in column 4 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 but the pesticide residues are not the pesticide residues of any pesticide specified, in column 2 of that Part, opposite to the food; or

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.content: is of a description specified in column 4 of Part 2 of that Schedule but the pesticide residues are not the pesticide residues of any pesticide specified, in column 2 of that Part, opposite to the food.

subsection.content: A person who contravenes subsection (1) commits an offence and is liable to a fine at level 5 and to imprisonment for 6 months.

section.name: s5
section.heading: Principles for determining MRL and EMRL for certain food (other than compounded food)

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: a food (other than compounded food) contains pesticide residues of a pesticide listed in Schedule 1 but the food is not specified in that Schedule opposite to the pesticide; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: a MRL or EMRL is specified for the residue definition of the pesticide in respect of a food that is the primary food commodity from which the food described in paragraph (a) is derived,

subsection.continued: subject to subsection (2), that MRL or EMRL is to apply to the food described in paragraph (a).

subsection.leadIn: If a food is in a dried, dehydrated or concentrated form, the MRL or EMRL is to be adjusted proportionately by reference to the ratio between the following—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the weight of the food in such form; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the weight of the food after dilution or reconstitution (as the case requires).

section.name: s6
section.heading: Principles for determining MRL and EMRL for compounded food

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: a compounded food contains pesticide residues of a pesticide listed in Schedule 1; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: any of the conditions set out in subsection (2) is met in respect of each of the ingredients of the compounded food,

subsection.continued: then, in relation to the compounded food, the MRL or EMRL for the residue definition of the pesticide is the aggregated sum of the pro-rata MRL or EMRL for the residue definition of the pesticide in respect of each of the ingredients of the compounded food (aggregated MRL or EMRL).

subsection.leadIn: The conditions referred to in subsection (1)(b) are—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the ingredient is a food in respect of which a MRL or EMRL is specified for the residue definition of the pesticide; or

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: by virtue of section 5, a MRL or EMRL for the residue definition of the pesticide is applicable to the ingredient.

subsection.def: ingredient (配料) means a food that is used as an ingredient of a compounded food;

pro-rata MRL or EMRL (按比例最高殘餘限量或最高再殘餘限量) means the percentage of the MRL or EMRL for the residue definition of the pesticide in respect of an ingredient that equals the percentage of the ingredient in the compounded food.

section.name: s7
section.heading: Factors for determining safety of food with pesticide residues

subsection.content: For the purpose of section 4(1)(f), in determining whether the consumption of a food is dangerous or prejudicial to health, the probability of known or potential adverse public health effects which may occur from dietary exposure of the general public to the pesticide residues concerned must be evaluated.

subsection.leadIn: Without limiting subsection (1), all factors relevant to the circumstances of the case may be taken into account, including—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: the toxicological profile and safety reference values of the pesticide concerned;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: the characteristics of the pesticide and the level of the pesticide residues in the food concerned;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: the consumption pattern of the food, and the long-term and short-term dietary exposure data of the general public and vulnerable groups to the pesticide residues;

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: any statutory requirement relating to the food;

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.content: information provided by an importer or supplier of the food;

paragraph.name: f
paragraph.content: information, reports or testing results provided by a public analyst;

paragraph.name: g
paragraph.content: information (including reports, warnings and decision documents) provided by an international food or health authority or the food or health authority of any place outside Hong Kong; and

paragraph.name: h
paragraph.leadIn: information on the source and extent of any hazard incurred by the presence of the pesticide residues in any food, in particular information on whether the hazard—

subparagraph.name: i
subparagraph.content: exists throughout or in any part of the manufacture or supply chain; or

subparagraph.name: ii
subparagraph.content: is limited to a particular batch of food.

section.name: s8
section.heading: Name in which proceedings may be brought
section.content: Without prejudice to any Ordinance relating to the prosecution of criminal offences or the powers of the Secretary for Justice relating to the prosecution of criminal offences, the prosecution of an offence under this Regulation may be brought in the name of the Director.

def.name: AquaticProducts
def.leadIn: aquatic products (水產) means any product derived from any edible part of any aquatic organism, including—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: fish;

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: fish roe;

paragraph.name: c
paragraph.content: edible offal of fish;

paragraph.name: d
paragraph.content: crustacean;

paragraph.name: e
paragraph.content: mollusc (including cephalopod); and

paragraph.name: f
paragraph.content: any other aquatic invertebrate animal,

def.continued: but does not include an amphibian, marine mammal or reptile;

def.name: MilkMilks
def.leadIn: milk and milks (奶、奶類) mean the normal mammary secretion of milking animals—

paragraph.name: a
paragraph.content: obtained from one or more milkings without either addition or extraction; and

paragraph.name: b
paragraph.content: is intended for consumption as liquid milk or for further processing.

section.name: s2
section.content: Where “(Fat)” forms part of the description of a food as set out in column 4 of Part 1 of this Schedule (or column 4 of Part 2 of this Schedule), it means that the MRL (or EMRL) for the residue definition of the pesticide specified, in column 3 of Part 1 of this Schedule (or column 3 of Part 2 of this Schedule), opposite to the food, applies only to the fat of the food.

section.name: s3

subparagraph.name: a
b
subparagraph.content: a MRL (or EMRL) for the residue definition of the pesticide applies to the food by virtue of section 5; and

subparagraph.name: c
subparagraph.content: “(F)” forms part of the description of the primary food commodity from which the food is derived (primary food) as set out in column 4 of Part 1 of this Schedule (or column 4 of Part 2 of this Schedule),

section.continued: the MRL (or EMRL) for the residue definition of the pesticide is to be determined in accordance with section 4 of this Part.

section.name: s4
section.leadIn: In relation to a food referred to in section 3 of this Part—

subparagraph.name: a
subparagraph.content: (where the fat content of the food is less than 2%) the MRL (or EMRL) for the residue definition of the pesticide specified, in column 3 of Part 1 of this Schedule (or column 3 of Part 2 of this Schedule), opposite to the primary food is to be construed as if it were reduced by 50%;

subparagraph.name: b
subparagraph.content: (where the fat content of the food is 2% or more) the MRL (or EMRL) for the residue definition of the pesticide specified, in column 3 of Part 1 of this Schedule (or column 3 of Part 2 of this Schedule), opposite to the primary food is to be construed as if it were multiplied by 25 and expressed on a fat basis.
